messages.author: 145239bce15505bd
messages.subject: Does Lavaan support 3 level MLMs?
parts:
If so, how would I go about it? This is what I have so far:
mlmodel <- '
  level: 1
    #Latent Variables
    DESSA =~ Q37_1 + Q37_2 + Q37_3 + Q37_4 + Q37_5 + Q37_6 + Q37_7 + Q37_8

  level: 2
    #Latent Variables
    DESSA =~ Q37_1 + Q37_2 + Q37_3 + Q37_4 + Q37_5 + Q37_6 + Q37_7 + Q37_8

    
  level: 3
    #Latent Variables
    DESSA =~ Q37_1 + Q37_2 + Q37_3 + Q37_4 + Q37_5 + Q37_6 + Q37_7 + Q37_8

'
mlfit <- sem(model = mlmodel, data = dfMain, cluster = c("Q24_4", "V1"))
summary(mlfit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
--------------------------------------
We just want to look at how the DESSA varies by Q24_4 (Early Childhood Educator) at level 2 and V1 (Classroom) at level 3. I was hoping that making cluster vector would work but it was likely wishful thinking. I can't find ANY documentation on how to do this but 3 level MLMs aren't uncommon so I was hoping this is possible in lavaan... Is it? And if so, should this work?

messages.author: a225fe7bebd5f312
messages.subject: Re: Does Lavaan support 3 level MLMs?
parts:
Not yet but it is planned.  See the lavaan development page: http://lavaan.ugent.be/development.html

Mplus does support 3-level models and perhaps other programs might.

Best,

Joe
